_comment: Boilerplate profile. Copy to <name>.json and apply with --profile <name>. Keys starting with _ are stripped. Overlay rules: object keys merge recursively, arrays are APPENDED to the base config (so listed mounts/caps add to, never replace, the defaults). See profiles/README.md.
_comment_caps: Extra capabilities to ADD on top of the --caps set (e.g. privileged-ish containers). Remove this block if not needed.
_comment_mounts: Bind your host paths and devices here. 'source' is on the HOST, 'destination' inside the container. Use rbind for binds; tmpfs for scratch/shm. EDIT every source path.
